name: Mount Eastice
description:
≺ About ≻

Welcome to Trenati Studio's diplomacy roundtable and showcase of operations in the Robloxian universe. Hang in our establishment on top of Mount Eastice, look at our latest clothing and memories, and fund our interdimensional arts.

Located on the remains of the White Cliffs of Eastice, this is one of the last surviving islands after the oceans rose from the Hundreds Raid War. Mount Eastice remains a neutral diplomatic territory for Robloxians visiting The Peace Summit's Planet Alapha, showcasing a lot of the planet's history while connecting the public to Trenati's monetary systems for clothing and art funding.

name: [Private Servers] Sunshadow Falls II
description:
A remastered version of Alpha Authority old Sunshadow Falls fort, developed in the 3rd year of Alpha Authority's existent. Dedicated to being a more secure facility for our trainers.

[RULES]: Follow trainer instructions, try to participate in any votes that happen in-game, and feel free to try any glitches. Have fun!

[COMMANDS - MAIN ADMIN]: :cmds

[COMMANDS - PENDING HUB]:
!accept all/username (Accepts access into Reserved Server)
!decline all/username (Declines access into Reserved Server)
!add username (Adds Pending Hub Cohost Admin perms)
!remove username (Removes Pending Hub Cohost Admin perms)
!addgroup groupid (Whitelists a Group)
!removegroup groupid (Blacklists a Group)
!setgroups groupid groupid .. (Whitelists multiple groups)

[COMMANDS - HOLO (DEMO)]:
!cc - Commands
!hosts - Hosts
!cohost [Name] - Cohost players that are in-game.
!uncohost [Name] - Uncohost players that are in or out of game.
!weapons - Weapons
!weapon [Name] - Load weapon.

name: [Private Servers] BTC III
description:
Private server version of Bamboo Training Core III. This game allows private server owners to host events with the holo's admin. Every private server owner has the ability to set admins for their private server, which has no crossover with other private servers.

!start - Start round.
!end - End round.
!cc - Commands
!hosts - Hosts
!cohost [Name] - Cohost players that are in-game.
!uncohost [Name] - Uncohost players that are in or out of game.
!maps - Maps
!map [Name] - Load map.
!weapons - Weapons
!weapon [Name] - Load weapon.
!os [Number] - Set outscore.

description:
≺ About ≻

Error 404. Location not found. Time travel intiated. Now loading... 

Welcome to Destiny Plaza II, heart of Retroholo's hub system. As Destiny Plaza II has sunken and was lost to time, for many years the happy hub remained untouched by Robloxians. Upon Trenati's discovery of time travel, this area of land was scanned from the 1900s and brought back as the heart of Retroholo's hub system.

Interest in training across Alpha Authority's past, from the 8th century to 21st century? Want to host an event across several thousand maps during Alpha Authority's existence? Well now you can!
